name: dsh-projects
description: Project and session management for DeepSeek Harness: searchable projects, organized sessions, archive center, and native folder picking.
longDescription: Adds a project layer on top of native DSH Workspace and Session data without migrating existing data. Includes searchable project switching, project creation, organized sessions, pin/favorite/manual sorting, global search, an archive center, light/dark theme support, and native folder picking on supported hosts. Windows Desktop is the primary verified environment; local Web UI uses the host picker with an in-app fallback. Alpha release — compatibility feedback is welcome.
